_meta.note: Values marked verified:false could not be sourced from data/reference and are community values. See UNKNOWNS.md. The first fixture read from the game settles them.

maxHealth.note: Naked level 50 Max Health with 0 attribute points. UESP Online:Health prose was archived as PDF only, not present in the repo.

maxMagicka.note: Naked level 50 Max Magicka with 0 attribute points.

maxStamina.note: Naked level 50 Max Stamina with 0 attribute points.

healthRecovery.note: Naked level 50 Health Recovery (per 2 second tick as shown on the sheet).

weaponDamage.note: Sheet Weapon Damage with no weapon equipped and no bonuses.

spellDamage.note: Sheet Spell Damage with no weapon equipped and no bonuses.

critChancePercent.note: Base Critical Chance for every character.

critDamagePercent.note: Base Critical Damage. Update 29 introduced the 125% cap.

critDamageCapPercent.note: Critical Damage cap. Class Mastery Above and Beyond raises it by 30 (skills.csv).

critRatingPerPercent.note: Critical rating needed for 1% Critical Chance at level 50 CP160.

resistancePerPercent.note: Physical or Spell Resistance rating per 1% of damage mitigation at level 50 CP160.

resistanceCapRating.note: Resistance cap, equals 50% mitigation at 660 per percent.

resistanceCapPercent.note: Mitigation shown at the resistance cap.

blockCost.note: Base Stamina cost of blocking an attack.

rollDodgeCost.note: Base Stamina cost of Roll Dodge.

sprintCostPerSecond.note: Base Stamina cost of Sprint per second.

breakFreeCost.note: Base Stamina cost of Break Free.

total.source: task statement (level 50 characters have 64 attribute points)

healthPerPoint.note: Max Health granted by one attribute point at level 50.

magickaPerPoint.note: Max Magicka granted by one attribute point at level 50.

staminaPerPoint.note: Max Stamina granted by one attribute point at level 50.

mundus.note: Values are level 50 CP160. fullDivines is the UESP figure with 7 gold Divines pieces (63.7%) and is kept as a cross check of the rounding rule. The Thief value is a critical rating.

The Steed.effect: Increases Health Recovery and Movement Speed

enchants.note: Truly Superb (CP160) gold glyph magnitudes. None of these are in data/reference; all are UNVERIFIED community values. Armor glyphs have a large value on head, chest, legs and shield, and a small value elsewhere.

large.note: Glyph of Prismatic Defense, large piece: Health, Magicka, Stamina

small.note: Glyph of Prismatic Defense, small piece: Health, Magicka, Stamina

magnitude.note: Glyph of Prismatic Recovery, each of the three recoveries

Glyph of Decrease Spell Harm. Magnitude and stat unknown, no sheet effect until settled.

weapon.note: Every weapon glyph is a combat proc and has no character sheet effect. Kept for completeness.

items.note: Armor rating of a gold CP160 piece with no trait, and weapon damage of a gold CP160 weapon. Not in data/reference. UNVERIFIED. Slot factors relative to the chest are the community understanding: chest 1.0, head shoulders legs feet 0.879, hands waist 0.5.

shieldArmor.note: Armor rating of a gold CP160 shield.

weaponDamage.note: Damage rating of any gold CP160 weapon. Applies to Weapon Damage and Spell Damage on the sheet.

twoHandedSetPieces.source: sets.csv settype Weapon rows hold their bonus in bonus_2 (2 items) for a single two handed weapon; task statement
twoHandedSetPieces.note: A two handed weapon counts as two set pieces.

battleSpirit.rawText: Damage taken and Shield strength are decreased by 50% Healing Received is decreased by 55% Health Recovery is decreased by 50% Ability range of 28 meters or more increased by 8

legacyFlatMaxHealth.note: Flat Max Health bonus referenced in 2016 to 2019 patch notes, applied after percentage multipliers (2016-01-26 note). Not listed by UESP now. Behind flags.battleSpiritFlatHealth, default off.

vampireStages.note: Unnatural Resistance (skills.csv) changes the Health Recovery penalty: stage 2 none, stage 3 25%, stage 4 50%. Applied by the engine when that passive is active.

championPoints.note: Stars from the UESP Champion page tables. Tables t00 to t03 are Craft, t04 to t12 Warfare, t13 to t22 Fitness. "Active" rows are slottable. Per stage effect text is parsed by tools/parse_effects; the engine applies max stages.

totalCap.note: Champion Point cap since Update 29, 1200 per constellation. Not in data/reference (patch notes html missing).
